# 0CodeKit

0CodeKit provides utility APIs for AI, document and image processing, data conversion, validation, generation, storage, and automation workflows.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/0codekit/.

## Actions

- **Calculate BMI** (read-only): Calculate body mass index and the provider's related desirable-weight, daily-energy, and nutrient estimates from weight in kilograms and…
- **Check Weekend** (read-only): Determine whether a date is a weekend and return its weekday name and day number.
- **Convert Nation and ISO Code** (read-only): Convert either an English country name to its ISO code or an ISO code to its English country name.
- **Find Keywords** (read-only): Search text for one or more keywords and report whether each occurs and the zero-based positions of matches.
- **Get Remaining Credits** (read-only): Return the number of 0CodeKit credits remaining for the connected API key.
- **Hash Message** (read-only): Generate a cryptographic digest or HMAC for a text message using a supported algorithm.
- **Parse UTM Parameters** (read-only): Extract standard UTM campaign parameters from a URL.
- **Validate Email** (read-only): Check an email address using 0CodeKit and return whether it is valid plus the provider's corrected-address value.
